newsitem.title: UK: Headlam to raise 17.3 mln stg for MCD buy.
newsitem.headline: Headlam to raise 17.3 mln stg for MCD buy.

text.p: British floorcoverings and textiles supplier Headlam Group Plc said on Wednesday it planned to buy British carpets group MCD (UK) Ltd for 30.1 million stg.
Headlam said it planned to raise a net 17.3 million stg in a one for nine share offer at 275 pence per share to fund the acquisition. The company said it would offer up to 6.78 million new shares.
Headlam said the acquisition would boost earnings per share in the first full year of ownership.

The company said the buoyant British market would ensure further growth in the enlarged group and said it planned to pay an interim dividend of not less than 1.75 pence per share for the six months to June 30, 1997.
